data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 提出ReTrace，通过失败回溯与交互验证，将修正固化为可复用操作技能并用于后续执行。

scope_support.feedback_quote: ReTrace retrospectively traces downstream failures to earlier decisions, proposes targeted corrections, and evaluates them through subsequent interactions.
scope_support.object_quote: Across attempts, ReTrace progressively consolidates validated corrections into a reusable manipulation skill that guide subsequent execution.
